_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Created an always-apply rule at `.cursor/rules/project-workflow.mdc`. It covers:

### Neon connectivity
Before any Neon read/write (queries, migrations, MCP, CLI, ingestion), the agent will ask you to switch to personal internet and wait for your confirmation. Network failures on office LAN are treated as connectivity issues, not credential/schema problems.

### Phase plans
Progress, scope changes, and completed tasks get updated in the existing phase files:
- `docs/PHASE_1_PLAN.md`
- `docs/PHASE_2_PLAN.md`
- `docs/PHASE_3_PLAN.md`

### Dhan API questions
Open items for the Dhan team go in `docs/DHAN_API_QUESTIONS.md` (numbered sections with docs vs. observed behavior).

### Observations
Live data findings go in `docs/OBSERVATIONS.md` (not buried in code comments or chat only).

The rule is set to `alwaysApply: true`, so it applies in every session. Your other rules (`holdings-tracker-plan.mdc`, `dhan-api-compliance.mdc`) stay unchanged.

Note: `.cursor/` is gitignored, so this rule lives locally on your machine. Say if you want it tracked in git (e.g. by adjusting `.gitignore`).
